Latest Announcements & Milestones

Official press announcements, research breakthroughs, regulatory compliance milestones, and global partnership news from SRIM WORKS.

SRIM WORKS Expands Global Delivery with Dedicated Autonomous AI Engineering Lab in Hyderabad

To meet surging enterprise demand for custom LLM fine-tuning, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows, SRIM WORKS has commissioned a new 100-seat specialized AI research and delivery lab in Hyderabad's Financial District.

SRIM WORKS Achieves SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 Security Certifications for Multi-Cloud Data Operations

Reinforcing our commitment to zero-trust architecture and rigorous data governance, SRIM WORKS has completed its annual SOC 2 Type II attestation and ISO 27001 certification for all enterprise cloud engineering and data annotation pipelines.

Accelerating European FinTech Modernization: Delivering Sub-50ms Distributed Core Banking Microservices

SRIM WORKS engineers have successfully deployed event-driven payment routing and automated KYC verification architectures for leading European financial institutions, achieving record sub-50ms p99 latency benchmarks.

Next-Gen 3D LiDAR & Spatial Sensor Fusion Datasets Released for Autonomous Robotics

Expanding our Computer Vision and Data Annotation practice, SRIM WORKS introduces advanced 3D cuboid and multi-sensor temporal tracking pipelines to support autonomous navigation and industrial robotics clients globally.

About SRIM WORKS (Corporate Boilerplate)

SRIM WORKS is a multinational digital engineering, artificial intelligence, and specialized data annotation technology firm headquartered in Hyderabad, India. With a dedicated team of over 300 domain engineers, data scientists, and cloud architects, SRIM WORKS builds and maintains mission-critical software systems, distributed microservices, and AI training pipelines for high-growth startups and global enterprises across North America, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.
